plateau.definition: For each of two consecutive completed epochs, weighted validation loss improves by less than 0.5% relative to the best preceding epoch and none of the three task losses improves by at least 1% relative to its best preceding value.

health_floor.scope: every validation domain and both masked_local and overview views of the selected best encoder

decision.continue: Continue through ten epochs while fewer than five epochs are complete, either plateau condition is false, or a later epoch restores material improvement.
decision.early_stop_candidate: After at least five completed epochs, stop at an epoch boundary only when both consecutive plateau epochs and every health floor pass.
decision.health_failure: A failed health floor is a Phase-2 failure or review condition, never a successful early stop.
decision.reversibility: Retain the full resumable checkpoint so a Phase-3 failure can resume the original ten-epoch schedule.

gate_change: The current gate still requires all ten registered epochs. It may accept an early stop only after it verifies this policy hash, the bound run-contract hash, the complete fixed-validation history, the best-encoder identity, and the plateau and health conditions.
